issues.item: Design - Profile screen vs F3 interests
issues.message: F3 and the database (interests, user_interests) support profile interests, but the Profile screen has only bio and course chips and no way to view or edit interests.
The Home bell says it opens a notifications list, but no Notifications screen is defined, although F5 requires the author to be notified of removals and the database has a notifications table.
Platform Administrator is listed as a user role (and exists in the roles table), but no feature, user story or screen describes what that role can do, such as assigning moderators.

required_fixes: Add an interests selector (backed by interests/user_interests) to the Profile screen's edit mode.
Add a Notifications screen or sheet, opened from the bell, that lists notification types such as note removed, join request outcome and account suspended.
Define Platform Administrator responsibilities, for example moderator role assignment and university and course management, in the requirements or remove the role.
recommendations: Add a star icon to the icon set, or specify the rating glyph, because the Star Rating Input currently uses a heart icon.
Clean up the malformed notifications index entry ('unique-free composite (user_id, is_read, created_at)') and store search_vector as a real tsvector type in the DDL.
Add a cover image field for study groups (the design shows a group image) and align the Download button text with image uploads rather than 'Download PDF' only.
